# Antigravity APP Account Manager

**Languages:** [简体中文](README.zh.md) | **English**

Quickly manage your Antigravity account**s**.

![Sample Screenshot](docs/assets/sample_screenshot.png)

## How To Use

Send one of the following messages to your Antigravity APP:

- **Install**:
  ```
  Install this plugin: https://github.com/InfSein/antigravity-app-account-manager
  ```
- **Update**: `Update Antigravity Account Manager plugin`
- **Uninstall**: `Uninstall Antigravity Account Manager plugin`

> For AI agents: see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and [SKILL.md](skills/account-manager/SKILL.md) for fast zero-dependency install, update, and uninstall instructions.

# Antigravity APP 账号管理插件

**Languages:** **简体中文** | [English](README.md)

轻松在你的多个 Antigravity 账号之间切换。

![Sample Screenshot](docs/assets/sample_screenshot.png)

## 使用方法

将下面的提示词发送给你的 Antigravity APP：

- **安装**：
  ```
  Install this plugin: https://github.com/InfSein/antigravity-app-account-manager
  ```
- **更新**：`更新 Antigravity 账号切换插件`
- **卸载**：`卸载 Antigravity 账号切换插件`

> Agent 执行规范详见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 与 [SKILL.md](skills/account-manager/SKILL.md)。
